articles.title: Amiga Unix, Again
articles.summary: 如果你对老系统复刻、复古计算感兴趣，这个项目又把 Amiga Unix 救活了一遍
articles.body:
Amiga Unix — Amix — was Commodore's System V Release 4 for the Amiga: shipped in 1990–92 for the A2500UX and A3000UX, then left where it stood. amigaux.org is an unofficial community project that picks it up again: Amix on 68040 and 68060 machines and on today's accelerator hardware, with a modern toolchain, a package manager, and drivers for cards that never had any. The work is done in the open, and written down as it happens in the grimoire .

By asokero, isoriano1968 and jusii.

The install medium boots from floppy and CD-ROM on real hardware — floppy image and ISO under emulation — and takes care of the whole installation, interactively or unattended. With supported hardware, getting Amix onto a machine comes down to following the prompts. The classic tape install follows later.

From there the network takes over: apkg installs packages straight from pkg.amigaux.org — grep, gzip, less, patch and zlib to start with, and more GNU and BSD tools as they are built and tested.

Part of this work is done with generative AI in the loop — models reading the old kernels in binary, as no source is available, and writing drivers and notes — with people setting direction, reviewing every change and testing on real hardware, where it either boots or it doesn't. Other parts are done the classic way. The grimoire records both, confidence-tagged, so you can see what is verified and what is still a guess.
articles.bodyZh:
Amiga Unix——也就是 Amix——是 Commodore 为 Amiga 打造的 System V Release 4：1990 到 1992 年间随 A2500UX 和 A3000UX 出货，然后就被原地搁置了。amigaux.org 是一个非官方的社区项目，把它重新捡了起来：让 Amix 跑在 68040 和 68060 机器上，也跑在今天的加速卡硬件上，配上现代工具链、包管理器，还有那些从来没人为它们写过驱动程序的板卡的驱动。这些工作都是公开进行的，而且边做边记录在一本“魔法书”（grimoire）里。

作者是 asokero、isoriano1968 和 jusii。

安装介质在真实硬件上可以从软盘和 CD-ROM 启动——在模拟器里则是软盘镜像和 ISO——整个安装过程全包了，可以交互式安装，也可以无人值守。只要硬件支持，把 Amix 装到机器上就是跟着提示走的事儿。经典的磁带安装稍后也会支持。

装好之后，就交给网络了：apkg 直接从 pkg.amigaux.org 安装软件包——先有 grep、gzip、less、patch 和 zlib，之后随着更多 GNU 和 BSD 工具被构建和测试，也会陆续加入。

这项工作的一部分是在生成式 AI 参与下完成的——让模型以二进制方式读取旧内核（因为没有源码可用），并编写驱动和笔记——同时由人来把握方向、审查每一处改动，并在真实硬件上测试，行就是行，不行就是不行。其他部分则用传统方式完成。那本“魔法书”把两种方式都记录在案，还标注了可信度，这样你就能看出哪些是已经验证过的，哪些还只是猜测。

articles.title: Spain Orders Blocks on Archive.today and Its Mirrors
articles.zh: 西班牙下令封锁 Archive.today 及其镜像站
articles.summary: 如果你平时靠 Archive.today 存档或查证内容，这波动向意味着以后访问会越来越难
articles.body:
No court ruling was required; only a complaint, a commission, and a censorship protocol built for speed.

If you’re tired of censorship and surveillance, subscribe to Reclaim The Net .

Spain’s Second Section of the Intellectual Property Commission, a part of the country’s Ministry of Culture, has ordered the blocking of several domains of the Archive.today service, a web archiving service.

It means that most Spanish internet users who try to access the site are redirected to a government page telling them that they are trying to access an “illegal” website.

The page, with the heading “ESTÁ USTED INTENTANDO ACCEDER A UN SITIO WEB ILEGAL” (“YOU ARE TRYING TO ACCESS AN ILLEGAL WEBSITE”), goes on to accuse the user of “facilitating illegal access to content protected by intellectual property rights” by visiting the site.

The full text of the accusation against the user is: “El acceso a esta página ha sido bloqueado mediante Resolución de la Sección Segunda de la Comisión de Propiedad Intelectual” (“Access to this page has been blocked by a resolution of the Second Section of the Intellectual Property Commission”) because of “facilitar ilegalmente el acceso a contenidos protegidos por derechos de propiedad intelectual” (“illegally facilitating access to content protected by intellectual property rights”).

The page then warns that by trying to access the content, the user “está contribuyendo a una actividad ilegal y delictiva, y poniendo en riesgo su seguridad, la de sus datos y dispositivos” (“is contributing to an illegal and criminal activity, and putting at risk your own security, that of your data and devices”).

Defend free speech and privacy online. Push back against digital ID, censorship, and surveillance.

Already a member? Sign in
articles.bodyZh:
根本不需要法院裁决；只要有人投诉、有个委员会，再加上一套专门追求速度的审查协议（censorship protocol），就够了。

如果你受够了审查和监控，就订阅 Reclaim The Net。

西班牙知识产权委员会（Intellectual Property Commission）第二分会——隶属于该国文化部（Ministry of Culture）——已经下令封锁 Archive.today 这个网页存档服务（web archiving service）的几个域名。

这意味着，大多数西班牙网民想访问这个网站时，都会被跳转到一个政府页面，页面上说他们正在试图访问一个“非法”网站。

这个页面的标题是“您正在试图访问一个非法网站”，接着还指责用户：访问这个网站就是在“为非法访问受知识产权保护的内容提供便利”。

对用户的完整指控是：“访问此页面已被知识产权委员会第二分会的决议封锁”，原因是“非法为访问受知识产权（intellectual property rights）保护的内容提供便利”。

页面随后警告说，用户试图访问这些内容，就是“在助长非法和犯罪行为，并且让自身安全、数据安全和设备安全都面临风险”。

articles.title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
articles.zh: AutoRecLab：描述实验，直接拿到代码
articles.summary: 如果你做推荐系统实验总在写数据加载和评测pipeline上耗时间，这个框架让你用自然语言描述实验就直接拿到可跑代码
articles.author: Moritz Baumgart, Philipp Meister 等
articles.body: Empirical evaluation is central to recommender-systems (RecSys) research, but turning experimental designs into executable code remains a manual and error-prone task. We present AutoRecLab, a Python-based autonomous RecSys lab that automates RecSys experiments from natural-language prompts. Given a research idea, AutoRecLab derives explicit experiment requirements, builds and validates a prototype, and iteratively expands it into the requested full experiment. The workflow combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for documentation lookup, static type verification, and execution-steered tree search. In our demonstration, AutoRecLab autonomously implements an explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion study. In a baseline comparison across six algorithms and three datasets, 8 of 9 runs succeed at an average cost of approx- imately $1 per run with GPT-5.4-mini.
articles.bodyZh: 在推荐系统（recommender systems，简称 RecSys）研究里，实证评估（empirical evaluation）是最核心的一环，可要把实验设计变成真能跑起来的代码，到现在还是个靠人工、又容易出错的活儿。我们带来了 AutoRecLab——一个用 Python 写的自主推荐系统实验室（autonomous RecSys lab），它能根据自然语言提示，把推荐系统实验自动化跑起来。你只要给它一个研究想法，AutoRecLab 就会先梳理出明确的实验需求，搭出一个原型并验证，再一轮轮扩展成你想要的完整实验。它这套工作流把几样东西合在一起：用检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation，RAG）查文档，用静态类型验证（static type verification）提前卡住类型问题，再用执行引导的树搜索（execution-steered tree search）来摸索怎么把实验跑通。在我们的演示里，AutoRecLab 自主实现了一项“显式反馈到隐式反馈的转换”（explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion）研究。在一次覆盖六种算法、三个数据集的基线对比（baseline comparison）中，9 次运行里有 8 次成功；用 GPT-5.4-mini 时，平均每次运行成本大约 1 美元。

articles.title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
articles.zh: TrialAtlas：面向临床试验设计与优化的多Agent研究组织
articles.summary: 如果你在找多Agent协作的真实落地场景，临床试验设计这种高门槛强流程的领域，可能比写代码更有说服力
articles.author: Jiacheng Lin, Zifeng Wang 等
articles.body: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three practical tasks: detecting trial design deficiencies, recommending actionable design improvements, and predicting technical and regulatory success. TrialAtlas achieves an F1 score of 50.0% for deficiency detection, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 points, and reaches 85.3% balanced accuracy and 84.7% F1 for prediction of technical and regulatory success, improving over the best baselines by 6.7 points in balanced accuracy and 12.0 points in Cohen's kappa. In expert evaluation, 86.4% of TrialAtlas-generated concerns were judged valid, compared with 83.1% for OpenAI DeepResearch and 59.3% for Gemini DeepResearch.
articles.bodyZh: 进入临床开发（clinical development）的药物，差不多 90% 最后都会失败，哪怕背后砸了几十亿美元。所以药企就得靠临床开发规划（clinical development planning, CDP）和“技术与监管成功概率评估”（probability of technical and regulatory success assessment）来提前预判开发风险。可这些决定还是很费人力、很主观，得让临床科学、统计、监管事务、竞争情报等各路专家一起，去收集、整合并推理各种不同类型的证据（heterogeneous evidence）。在这里，我们推出 TrialAtlas——一个记忆增强（memory-augmented）的多智能体（multi-agent）研究组织，专门用于 CDP，它通过协调多个专门智能体来模拟这种协作过程：文献综合（literature synthesis）、竞争试验情报（competitive trial intelligence）、监管先例分析（regulatory precedent analysis），以及对试验设计和开发风险做综合推理（integrated reasoning）。TrialAtlas 还会从历史临床试验和监管结果里学习，包括以前的新药申请（New Drug Applications, NDAs），让自己的决策建立在积累下来的开发经验上。为了在真实监管场景里评估这些能力，我们推出 TrialAtlasBench，它是从 291 封 FDA 完整回复函（Complete Response Letters）构建出来的，覆盖三个实操任务：找出试验设计缺陷、给出能落地的设计改进建议，以及预测技术和监管能不能成功。TrialAtlas 在缺陷检测上的 F1 分数（F1 score）达到 50.0%，比最强基线（baseline）高 6.1 个百分点；在预测技术与监管成功上，平衡准确率（balanced accuracy）达到 85.3%，F1 达到 84.7%，比最好的基线在平衡准确率上高 6.7 个百分点，在科恩卡帕系数（Cohen's kappa）上高 12.0 个百分点。在专家评估里，TrialAtlas 提出的关切点有 86.4% 被判定为有效，OpenAI DeepResearch 是 83.1%，Gemini DeepResearch 是 59.3%。

articles.title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
articles.zh: 经过人格微调的LLM能成为更好的社交Agent吗？
articles.summary: 如果你正准备给自己的Agent配个人设，这篇的结论会告诉你人格微调到底有没有用、坑在哪
articles.author: Tim Krabbe, Xiaodan Shi
articles.body: LLMs are increasingly used in social simulations for socially interactive agents and robots, offering more flexibility than rule-based systems. However, even though they mimic human behaviour very well, there is a persistent alienness to them. This work investigates whether personality-aware fine-tuning can reduce this gap by improving the consistency and controllability of personality-conditioned dialogue generation compared with instruction prompting alone. We fine-tune two small open-weight LLMs, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct, using a corpus that combines personality-labelled social media posts and dialogues to create a personality-based dialogue engine for social simulation. The resulting models are evaluated across multiple social interaction scenarios using three independent LLM judges, which assess personality fidelity and provide evidence-based behavioral interpretations. We additionally quantify inter-rater agreement and lexical characteristics of the generated dialogue. Results indicate that fine-tuned models are not better at role-playing different personalities than their respective baseline models. However, low inter-rater agreement limits the confidence with which these results can be interpreted. Concerning the quality of generated texts, fine-tuned models are mostly comparable to the baselines, with fine-tuning improving the linguistic diversity of the Qwen models. While the results appear generally usable and the baseline models offer the best overall performance, future studies should place greater emphasis on the quality and domain alignment of training data for accurate personality role-playing.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，大语言模型（LLMs）在社交模拟（social simulations）里越来越常见，用来驱动能跟人互动的智能体（agents）和机器人，而且比基于规则的系统（rule-based systems）灵活得多。不过，尽管它们能把人类行为模仿得很像，但总还是有一种挥之不去的“异类感”。这项研究想搞清楚：跟只用指令提示（instruction prompting）相比，个性感知微调（personality-aware fine-tuning）能不能通过提升以个性为条件的对话生成（personality-conditioned dialogue generation）的一致性和可控性，来缩小这个差距。我们微调了两个小型开放权重的大语言模型（open-weight LLMs）——Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Ministral-8B-Instruct，用的语料库把带个性标签的社交媒体帖子和对话结合起来，目的是做出一个基于个性的对话引擎（personality-based dialogue engine），专门用于社交模拟。然后，我们用三个独立的大语言模型评审（LLM judges）在多种社交互动场景里评估这些训练出来的模型。这些评审会判断个性保真度（personality fidelity），还会给出有证据支撑的行为解读。我们还量化了评分者间一致性（inter-rater agreement）以及生成对话的词汇特征（lexical characteristics）。结果表明，在扮演不同个性这件事上，微调后的模型并不比它们各自的基线模型（baseline models）更强。不过，评分者间一致性偏低，这就限制了我们能对这些结果抱有多大信心。说到生成文本的质量，微调模型大多跟基线模型差不多，但微调确实提升了 Qwen 系列模型的语言多样性（linguistic diversity）。虽然这些结果看起来总体上能用，而且基线模型整体表现最好，但未来的研究应该更加重视训练数据的质量和领域对齐（domain alignment），这样才能让模型准确地进行个性角色扮演（role-playing）。

articles.title: Reusing Latent Speech Representations for Query-Conditioned Topic Localization in Transcripts
articles.zh: 复用语音隐表征实现转写文本中查询条件下的主题定位
articles.summary: 如果你在做会议记录、播客这类长音频的内容检索定位，这篇给了一个不用重新训练的思路
articles.author: Steffen Freisinger, Philipp Seeberger 等
articles.body: Long transcripts are costly inputs for downstream NLP systems and often contain irrelevant context. We study query-conditioned topic localization: predicting the sentence span in a transcript that best addresses a topic-title query. To improve span localization, we reuse ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations and fuse them with textual embeddings. This lets lightweight span locators exploit speech information without running a separate audio encoder. Experiments on two public datasets show consistent gains over text-only baselines, especially under strict boundary-matching criteria. Cross-dataset experiments further indicate that the benefits are strongest for structured or semi-structured speech, while gains on spontaneous speech are limited and mixed.
articles.bodyZh: 长转录文本对于下游自然语言处理系统来说，既是一种昂贵的输入，又常常包含许多无关的上下文。我们研究了一种叫做“查询条件主题定位”的任务：预测转录文本中哪一段句子最能回应对应主题标题的查询。为了更好地定位相关片段，我们重新利用了自动语音识别（ASR）编码器的状态，作为句子级别的表示，并将它们与文本嵌入融合。这样一来，轻量级的片段定位器就能利用语音信息，而不需要额外运行一个独立的音频编码器。在两个公开数据集上的实验表明，相比仅使用文本的基线方法，这种融合方式能带来稳定的提升，尤其是在严格的边界匹配标准下更为明显。跨数据集的实验进一步显示，这种优势在结构化或半结构化语音中最突出，而在即兴口语场景中，提升则有限且表现不一。

articles.title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
articles.zh: EnterpriseVal：量化生成式AI在企业中的效能、可靠性与价值
articles.summary: 如果你要向老板证明GenAI的投入值不值，这篇给了一套可参考的量化评估口径
articles.author: Abbas Raza Ali, Muhammad Ajmal Siddiqui 等
articles.body: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our controls?". We present EnterpriseVal, a use-case-level evaluation system that closes this gap. It comprises (i) a formal specification of the use case and of the frozen socio-technical configuration under test, model, prompts, retrieval, tools, guardrails and human oversight, with an autonomy level and consequence tier that jointly set the required evaluation intensity; (ii) a metric catalogue spanning fidelity, utility, efficiency, reliability, assurance and oversight; (iii) a grading protocol that scales blinded expert judgement with calibrated LLM-as-judge scoring through prediction-powered inference; (iv) a two-tier threshold gate, stated as an executable algorithm, that maps metric vectors with confidence bounds to REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE decisions; and (v) a value-and-risk model in which the reviewer catch rate is a measured parameter. We report a pilot across three workflows in a global bank. In credit-memo drafting, human-graded citation precision reached 88% and hallucination rate 1.6% for the best model against gates of 70% and 5%; in procedure transformation, analyst refinement effort fell from an estimated 27.4 to 2.9 hours per document. We separate established results, documented pilot evidence, the proposed system and open hypotheses, and specify the experiments required for full validation
articles.bodyZh: 现在的前沿语言模型（frontier language models）已经能产出相当专业的交付成果，在不少有经济价值的任务上，专家评分员给出的评价已经能跟人干出来的活打个平手。可另一方面，大多数企业搞的生成式AI（GenAI）项目，最后都拿不出能看得见的业务效果，还有很大一部分智能体（agentic）项目估计要被砍掉。我们认为，这在很大程度上是个"度量"的问题：公开的基准测试（benchmark）回答的是"这模型能干什么"，可要做部署决策，你得回答的是"这个工作流程合不合适、靠不靠谱、安不安全、值不值得放大——而且是在我们自己的数据上、在我们自己的管控之下？"。为此我们提出了 EnterpriseVal，一套按用例（use case）来做的评估系统，专门来补这个缺口。它包含这么几块：（一）把用例本身、以及被测的那套"冻结"的社会技术配置（socio-technical configuration）——模型、提示词（prompt）、检索（retrieval）、工具（tool）、护栏（guardrail）、人工监督——都写成正式规范，再配一个自主性等级（autonomy level）和一个后果等级（consequence tier），两者共同决定评估该做到多重；（二）一套指标目录，覆盖保真度（fidelity）、效用（utility）、效率（efficiency）、可靠性（reliability）、保障（assurance）和监督（oversight）；（三）一套评分协议，把盲评的专家判断，通过预测驱动推断（prediction-powered inference）跟经过校准的"让大模型当裁判"（LLM-as-judge）打分结合起来，从而放大规模；（四）一道两级阈值闸门（two-tier threshold gate），写成可执行的算法，把带置信边界的指标向量映射成"拒绝／有条件通过／规模化推广"（REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE）三种决策；（五）一个价值与风险模型，其中审核者的发现率（reviewer catch rate）是一个实测参数。我们在一家全球性银行里，跨三个工作流程做了试点。在信贷备忘录起草上，最好的模型人工评出的引用准确率达到88%，幻觉率1.6%，而门槛分别是70%和5%；在流程改造上，分析师的修改工作量从估计的每份文件27.4小时降到了2.9小时。我们把已经确立的结论、试点中记录到的证据、我们提出的这套系统、以及还没验证的假设分了开来，并把要完整验证这套系统需要做哪些实验，也一并说明清楚了。

articles.title: Federated Deep Clustering Networks for High-Dimensional and Heterogeneous Data
articles.zh: 面向高维异构数据的联邦深度聚类网络
articles.summary: 如果你在医疗、金融这类数据不能出域的场景做聚类，这篇讲的是联邦框架下怎么啃高维异构这块硬骨头
articles.author: Morris Stallmann, Charalampos S. Kouzinopoulos 等
articles.body: Clustering high-dimensional data is a fundamental task in unsupervised machine learning with applications to a variety of domains. In the centralized data scenario, this task is commonly solved using deep clustering methods that utilize deep neural network architectures to learn clustering-friendly latent space representations. In Federated Learning, where data is distributed between clients and is private, deep clustering methods are less explored. In particular, recently introduced federated deep clustering methods, despite showing very promising performance, still fall short in reliably providing good performance if data across clients are non-identically-independently distributed. In this work, we introduce a generalization of Deep Clustering Networks to the federated scenario, named FedDCN, that simultaneously optimizes a reconstruction loss and a clustering loss. To ensure robustness and latent space alignment in non-identically-independently distributed data scenarios, FedDCN generates synthetic data augmentations, and its learning objective includes a geometric regularization for latent space alignment. Through experimental evaluation, the effectiveness of the approach under IID and non-IID assumptions is demonstrated, and future research directions are identified.
articles.bodyZh: 给高维数据做聚类，是无监督机器学习（unsupervised machine learning）里的一项基础任务，很多领域都会用到。要是数据都集中在同一个地方，通常就会用深度聚类方法（deep clustering methods）来解决：靠深度神经网络架构（deep neural network architectures）去学一种“对聚类友好”的潜在空间表示（latent space representations）。到了联邦学习（Federated Learning）里，数据分散在各个客户端上，而且还得保护隐私，深度聚类的方法研究得就没那么多。尤其是最近提出的一些联邦深度聚类方法（federated deep clustering methods），虽然表现看着很有希望，可一旦各个客户端的数据不是独立同分布（non-identically-independently distributed），它们就很难稳定地给出好效果。我们这项工作中，把深度聚类网络（Deep Clustering Networks）推广到了联邦场景，起名叫 FedDCN；它会同时优化重构损失（reconstruction loss）和聚类损失（clustering loss）。为了保证在非独立同分布的数据场景下也够鲁棒，并且让潜在空间能对齐，FedDCN 会生成合成数据增强（synthetic data augmentations），它的学习目标里还加入了一个做潜在空间对齐的几何正则化（geometric regularization）。通过实验评估，我们证明了这套方法在独立同分布（IID）和非独立同分布（non-IID）假设下都有效，也指出了未来的研究方向。

articles.title: Touvigation: Embodied Adaptive Object Acquisition for Blind and Low-Vision Users in Unfamiliar Indoor Environments
articles.zh: Touvigation：面向陌生室内环境中视障用户的具身自适应物品获取
articles.summary: 如果你关注具身智能的公益向落地，这篇做的是帮视障用户在陌生建筑里自己找到目标物品
articles.author: George Xi Wang, Xiangyu Li 等
articles.body: Blind and low-vision users often face challenges when locating and physically acquiring objects in unfamiliar indoor environments. Existing vision-language-model-based assistants can provide semantic descriptions but may introduce latency, hallucinations, and guidance that is poorly aligned with embodied action. We present Touvigation, a hands-free object acquisition system that combines vision-language understanding with persistent local spatial modeling to provide low-latency, body-relative guidance. Drawing on formative interviews with eight blind and low-vision participants, we design a multi-stage guidance framework that adapts spatial references as users transition from orienting, to walking, to reaching and tactile verification. We evaluated Touvigation with 12 blind and low-vision participants against a multimodal large-language-model assistant and unassisted search. Touvigation achieved 100% task success, compared with 58% for the multimodal assistant and 85% for unassisted search, while reducing completion time and cognitive workload. Our findings demonstrate how persistent spatial grounding and adaptive embodied guidance can improve object acquisition for blind and low-vision users.
articles.bodyZh: 盲人和低视力（blind and low-vision）朋友在不熟悉的室内环境里找东西、拿到东西，经常会遇到不少难题。现有那些基于视觉语言模型（vision-language model, VLM）的助手，虽然能给出语义描述（semantic descriptions），但可能会反应慢、出现延迟（latency），还会产生幻觉（hallucinations），而且给出的指引常常跟用户实际的身体动作（embodied action）对不上。我们提出了 Touvigation，这是一个免手操作（hands-free）的物体获取系统（object acquisition system），把视觉语言理解和持续的本地空间建模（persistent local spatial modeling）结合起来，提供低延迟、以身体为参照的引导（body-relative guidance）。我们根据对 8 位盲人和低视力参与者的形成性访谈（formative interviews），设计了一套多阶段引导框架（multi-stage guidance framework），它会随着用户从定向（orienting）、到行走（walking）、再到伸手够取（reaching）和触觉确认（tactile verification）这些不同阶段，灵活调整空间参照（spatial references）。我们找了 12 位盲人和低视力参与者来评估 Touvigation，拿它跟多模态大语言模型（multimodal large-language-model）助手以及无辅助搜索（unassisted search）作对比。结果 Touvigation 的任务成功率达到 100%，多模态助手只有 58%，无辅助搜索是 85%；同时它还缩短了完成时间，降低了认知负荷（cognitive workload）。我们的发现说明，持久的空间锚定（persistent spatial grounding）加上自适应具身引导（adaptive embodied guidance），能帮盲人和低视力用户更顺利地拿到东西。

articles.title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
articles.zh: RheoSampling：解决随机动态树投机解码中的one-hot困境
articles.summary: 如果你在做推理加速、盯过投机解码的采样策略，这篇针对的正是随机采样场景下动态树失效的具体瓶颈
articles.author: Qiao Hu, Yepeng Weng 等
articles.body: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel, with tree-based methods further improving efficiency through hierarchical structures. Dynamic-tree methods such as EAGLE-3 perform well under greedy decoding via deterministic top-K expansion and global pruning. However, in stochastic decoding (T>0), this mechanism collapses the draft distribution into one-hot probabilities, causing a severe drop in acceptance rate. This creates a dilemma: dynamic-tree methods sacrifice stochastic sampling to preserve context-aware topology, while static-tree methods preserve stochastic sampling with context-agnostic structures. The issue arises because the same probability distribution is used for two conflicting tasks: constructing the tree and verifying tokens. This coupling makes direct injection of randomness challenging due to the resulting stochastic process. We resolve this by decoupling these roles: RheoSampling assigns a token sampled from the draft distribution a proxy probability for tree expansion and pruning alongside its true sampling probability for verification. Specifically, we inject a sampled token among the deterministic top-K slots and treat it with different probabilities during construction and verification, making RheoSampling the first dynamic-tree method with both context-aware top-K construction and stochastic sampling while maintaining losslessness. We establish the lossless guarantee through an equivalence-class analysis that compresses the stochastic tree space into tractable classes. An OT-based verification strategy and a sparse draft mechanism ensure that theoretical gains translate into practical efficiency. Experiments across LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate improvements in acceptance rate and speedup over state-of-the-art dynamic tree methods. This framework may provide a template for analyzing stochastic tree structures.
articles.bodyZh:
投机解码（speculative decoding）能加速大语言模型（LLM）推理，方法是并行地草拟多个 token（标记）。而基于树的方法（tree-based methods）通过分层结构，把效率又往上提了一截。

像 EAGLE-3 这样的动态树方法（dynamic-tree methods），在贪婪解码（greedy decoding）下表现很好，靠的是确定性的 top-K 扩展（deterministic top-K expansion）和全局剪枝（global pruning）。

但是，到了随机解码（stochastic decoding，温度 T>0）的时候，这套机制会把草稿分布（draft distribution）压缩成独热概率（one-hot probabilities），导致接受率（acceptance rate）严重下滑。

这就造成了一个两难局面：动态树方法为了保住上下文感知的拓扑结构（context-aware topology），牺牲了随机采样（stochastic sampling）；而静态树方法（static-tree methods）虽然保住了随机采样，用的却是上下文无关的结构（context-agnostic structures）。

问题的根源在于，同一个概率分布（probability distribution）被用在了两个互相冲突的任务上：一个用来构建树（constructing the tree），一个用来验证 token（verifying tokens）。

这种耦合（coupling）让直接注入随机性变得很难，因为会带来一个随机过程（stochastic process）。

我们通过把这两个角色解耦（decoupling）来解决这个问题：RheoSampling 会给从草稿分布里采样出来的 token 分配一个代理概率（proxy probability），用于树的扩展和剪枝（tree expansion and pruning），同时保留它真实的采样概率（true sampling probability）用于验证。

具体来说，我们会把一个采样出来的 token 塞进确定性的 top-K 槽位里，并且在构建和验证阶段用不同的概率来对待它。这让 RheoSampling 成为第一个既有上下文感知的 top-K 构建，又能随机采样，同时还保持无损（losslessness）的动态树方法。

我们通过一种等价类分析（equivalence-class analysis）来证明无损保证，这种分析把随机树空间（stochastic tree space）压缩成可处理的类别（tractable classes）。

基于最优传输（OT）的验证策略和稀疏草稿机制（sparse draft mechanism），确保理论上的收益能转化成实际效率。

在不同 LLM 和基准测试（benchmarks）上的实验表明，跟最先进的（state-of-the-art）动态树方法相比，我们的方法在接受率和加速比上都有提升。

这个框架（framework）也许能提供一个模板，用来分析随机树结构。
